source='''import numpy as np

def transform(grid):
    a = np.array(grid, dtype=int)
    colors = [int(x) for x in np.unique(a) if x != 0]
    marker = min(colors, key=lambda color: np.count_nonzero(a == color))
    points = np.argwhere(a == marker)
    origin = points.min(axis=0)
    shape = [tuple(p - origin) for p in points]
    height = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = a.copy()
    for r in range(a.shape[0] - height + 1):
        for c in range(a.shape[1] - width + 1):
            if all(a[r + dr, c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr, c + dc] = marker
    return out.tolist()
'''
